title: Partial settlement: duty of care paid, compensation wrongly refused
narrative: They paid my hotel bill but said the cancellation itself was weather so no compensation. Should I just take it?

documents.content:
BOOKING OR6614 — Passenger: F. LINDQVIST (adult)
Carrier: Orion Reach (OR)
OR480  VIE 08 Oct 2026 19:45  ->  IST 08 Oct 2026 23:20
Great-circle distance VIE-IST: 2,900 km. Onward none.
Status: CONFIRMED.

From: ops@orionreach.example
Sent: 08 Oct 2026 17:10 UTC
Subject: OR480 cancelled

OR480 tonight is cancelled. You are rebooked on OR482 tomorrow at 19:45.

ORION REACH OPS LOG — OR480 / 08OCT2026
Status: CANCELLED
Cause code: FLT-IT
Cause text: OR crew-rostering and dispatch platform outage 08OCT 14:00-23:00Z. Internal.
Weather VIE and IST: no restriction, both stations CAVOK. No ATC regulation applied to this rotation.
ITEMISED RECEIPTS: airport hotel 08-09 Oct 245.00 units, evening meal 38.00 units, breakfast 17.00 units. TOTAL 300.00 units.
ORION REACH SETTLEMENT NOTE, 02 Nov 2026: duty-of-care reimbursement of 300.00 units paid to F. LINDQVIST in respect of OR480. Compensation element refused, see decision letter.
CHECK-IN CONFIRMATION OR480 08OCT2026 — LINDQVIST/F — accepted for travel 17:02Z. Flight subsequently cancelled.

carrier_response.text: We have reimbursed your expenses of 300.00 units in full. Compensation is however not payable, as OR480 was cancelled due to adverse weather conditions constituting an extraordinary circumstance.

derivation: S3.6 the operational record governs over the carrier's stated weather ground
S3.2(c) carrier's own rostering and dispatch platform outage -> carrier-controlled
S4.1 notice 08 Oct 17:10 -> 08 Oct 19:45 is under 7 days -> 100%
S4.4 the re-route arrived roughly 24 hours late, far outside the 2h window -> no exemption
S6.3 duty of care of 300.00 units is at the cap and has been settled correctly
S9.3 a partial settlement is challengeable on the refused portion only
S9.1(a) the refused compensation element cites S3.3 against a record showing S3.2 -> challenge
S10.1(b) escalation is not yet available; the challenge must be put to the carrier first
